name: bank
author: Takaro
description: A savings bank that gives currency a reason to be saved. Players move currency between their wallet and a separate bank balance with bank deposit and bank withdraw. Bank balances earn interest on a schedule (daily by default), with a configurable rate, a cap per payout and a minimum balance. VIP roles can earn a higher rate. An optional withdraw fee and balance cap keep the economy in check. Admins see totals and top savers with bankstats.
summary: A savings bank: players deposit and withdraw currency to a separate bank balance that earns daily interest (rate, cap, minimum balance, VIP rate via permission count). Optional withdraw fee and balance cap. Admin bankstats shows total held and top savers.

interestRatePercent.title: Interest rate (%)
interestRatePercent.description: Interest paid on a bank balance at each payout, in percent. The payout runs daily by default (change the payInterest cron job to change how often). Set to 0 to turn interest off.

maxInterestPerPayout.title: Max interest per payout
maxInterestPerPayout.description: The most interest one player can earn in a single payout (daily by default). Set to 0 for no cap.

minimumBalanceForInterest.title: Minimum balance for interest
minimumBalanceForInterest.description: A bank balance must be at least this high to earn interest.

withdrawFeePercent.title: Withdraw fee (%)
withdrawFeePercent.description: Percentage of each withdrawal kept by the bank as a fee (rounded down). Set to 0 for no fee.

maxBankBalance.title: Max bank balance
maxBankBalance.description: The most a player can hold in the bank. Deposits and interest stop at this amount. Set to 0 for no limit.

topSaversCount.title: Top savers shown
topSaversCount.description: How many top savers the bankstats command lists.

permissions.description: Earn a higher interest rate in the bank. The count is the interest rate in percent (for example 3 = 3%). It is only used when it is higher than the normal rate.
Allows using the bankstats command to see the total held in the bank and the top savers.

bank.description: Check your bank balance, or deposit and withdraw currency.
bank.helpText: bank: show your bank balance and next interest. bank deposit <amount|all>: move currency from your wallet into the bank. bank withdraw <amount|all>: move currency from the bank to your wallet.

bankstats.description: Admin: show the total held in the bank and the top savers.
bankstats.helpText: Shows the number of bank accounts, the total held, the interest paid so far and the top savers.

payInterest.description: Pays interest on every bank balance that meets the minimum.
